issue_context.title: [Enhancement] Add LMQ stats
issue_context.body:
### Before Creating the Enhancement Request

- [X] I have confirmed that this should be classified as an enhancement rather than a bug/feature.


### Summary

Currently, LMQ has no PUT stats, and GET stats are all aggregated to one topic `%LMQ%`.
It is better to record LMQ PUT stats and save GET stats respectively.

### Motivation

LMQ has no accurate stats.

### Describe the Solution You'd Like

PUT stats: record when LMQ dispatch.
GET stats: do not aggregate to one topic when recording.

### Describe Alternatives You've Considered

none

### Additional Context

_No response_
